feeds.title: The Good Life Backyard Blog
feeds.description: The good life backyard is an independent family business based in the Sunshine Coast Region of Australia. Their mission is to provide quality service and quality Australian chicken keeping products. They have partnered with Australia's most trusted source of biodiverse carbon offsets, Greenfleet, a leading environmental non-profit organisation. Dive into their blog for tips, tricks, they offer to help you in your journey of keeping backyard chickens and seek knowledge on healthy chickens.

feeds.title: Somerzby Blog
feeds.description: Somerzby is an Australian based business operating from their warehouse in Somersby on the Central Coast, since 2010. They sell directly to the public via their website, having thousands of happy and returning customers who love their practical designs, quality products and cheap prices. Go through their blog and get more information about small animal coops, hutches, chicken feeders, keeping and care of small animals, and more.

feeds.title: Omlet Blog Australia » Chickens
feeds.description: Explore Omlet's blog to discover more information about pets, their cages, food, chickens, etc. Omlet is a pet supply firm that offers advice on how to bond with your animals. They created a ground-breaking new chicken coop that made keeping hens in gardens easier. The unique concepts and unwavering attention to detail in the pet cage designs have pleased thousands of pets and their owners worldwide.

feeds.title: Free Range Eggs
feeds.description: Grantville is the owner of free-ranger in the southern Australian state of Victoria. His farm runs sheep, cattle and horses as well as laying hens - a genuine mixed farm. As much as possible recycled materials are used, solar power helps to achieve their sustainability aims and the farm is carbon negative. Explore more knowledge on poultry farms through his blog.

feeds.title: Adelaide Chicken Sitting Service Blog
feeds.description: Adelaide Chicken Sitting Service is owned and operated by Janine Zschech. She is your poultry support service that comes to your home. She raises a variety of extremely healthy purebred and hybrid egg/meat females. In order to keep your pets happy, healthy, and relaxed while you are away, she offers pet sitting services. Dive into her blog to learn more about pet sitting, teaching, advice, services, and more.

feeds.title: National Poultry Newspaper News
feeds.description: National Poultry Newspaper features poultry news articles from industry professionals regarding research projects and outcomes, industry happenings, relevant poultry news and upcoming poultry and agricultural events. Wade through the blog to get latest news, articles, advertisements, and more.

feeds.title: Chicken Coach Blog
feeds.description: Chicken Coach Blog is authored by Elise McNamara. Her particular passions are permaculture, practical garden design, and keeping chickens. She successfully raises hens in public places. She assists in adding poultry to your farm's diversification. Visit her site to learn how to raise chickens, plan a workshop or masterclass for your feed store, school, or community organization, find supplies, and more.

feeds.title: Barastoc Poultry Blog
feeds.description: At Barastoc they firmly believe in putting the chicken before the egg. They have learned over more than 75 years of feeding poultry that chooks who are healthy, content, and well-fed lay better eggs more frequently. The blog is designed to help all backyard poultry owners and provides helpful tips, articles, goods, books, events, information, and more on how to feed and take care of backyard flocks.
